name: Send To Phone
description: Provides various tools for sending bits of information via SMS.
project_description: Submodule of SMS Framework (2.4.x / v2). Adds a 'Send to phone' feature that texts bits of content to a phone: a node link (per configured content type), a text-field formatter ('SMS Link') and widget, and an [sms]...[/sms] text-format filter, all pointing at a send form at /sms/sendtophone/{type}/{extra}. An admin form at /admin/config/smsframework/sendtophone selects which content types show the link. Permission 'send to any number' allows sending to arbitrary numbers; otherwise a user may send to their own confirmed number. Depends on smsframework:sms.
